create_BBoxes3D_object: create a BBoxes3D object from a list of tensors with shape (num_boxes, 3, 2) representing 3D bounding box bounds
compute_box3d_overlap: compute the volume and IoU of intersection between two sets of 3D bounding boxes using box3d_overlap_from_bounds
calculate_box3d_intersection: calculate intersection volume, IoU scores, and intersection bounds between two sets of 3D bounding boxes
apply_box3d_nms: apply non-maximum suppression to 3D bounding boxes using confidence scores and an IoU threshold
convert_bounds_to_verts: convert 3D bounding box bounds tensors to 8 corner vertex coordinates with optional rotation
